read.thesis: Q1 EBITDA beat from Medicaid supplemental payments ($200M vs $80M expected) masked a ~$180M weather/flu volume hit; guidance held, with supplemental benefit now guided to fall $50M-$250M y/y.

utilisation.quote: Our occupancy levels continue to be at high levels for us

capex.quote: Capital expenditures totaled $1.1 billion in the quarter.

triggers.label: Denials and underpayments still high
triggers.quote: Denials and underpayments are still really high

triggers.label: Uninsured admissions up 16%
triggers.quote: we estimate same-facility uninsured equivalent admissions increased approximately 16% versus the prior-year quarter

triggers.label: Supplemental benefit guide now $50M-$250M decline
triggers.quote: We are adjusting our full-year range to reflect a decline in supplemental payment program net benefit between $50 million to $250 million versus prior year

triggers.label: 2026 fully contracted at target levels
triggers.quote: For 2026, we are pretty much fully contracted at our targeted levels

guidance.quote: we believe we will be able to run between 2% to 3% volume growth in the next three quarters over prior year
we still believe our full-year range of $600 million to $900 million expected impact on adjusted EBITDA is appropriate
